coordinateFrame.sourceLocal: local metres about ORIGIN; north -z, east +x
coordinateFrame.inverseFormula: longitude = origin.lon + x / (mPerLat*cos(origin.lat)); latitude = origin.lat - z/mPerLat
coordinateFrame.localWarning: Legacy local +x east and -z north are not exactly EPSG grid axes; project every vertex.
coordinateFrame.outputVerticalReference: RH2000 only when explicitly supplied by the separate laser report
